findings.reason: The protected SQL implementation uses a UNION ALL common table expression to split call records into individual caller and callee endpoints, joins through Person to Country via three-character phone_number prefix slicing, and compares country-level AVG(duration) against global SELECT AVG(duration) FROM Calls via HAVING. The approach is optimal, explicit, and portable; no candidate is required.

UNION ALL ensures each call duration contributes once to caller's country and once to callee's country (contributing twice for domestic calls). Grouping by country_code and country name calculates the exact endpoint-weighted country average, and HAVING AVG(e.duration) > (SELECT AVG(duration) FROM Calls) excludes countries equal to or below the global average.

Scanning Calls to form 2L endpoints, joining to P people and C countries, and grouping takes O((P + C + E) log E) time and O(P + C + E) working space under portable sort-based aggregation, or expected linear time under hash joins. Complexity evidence is inherited and hash-bound.
Outputs the single required column 'country', excludes countries without incident call endpoints, applies strict inequality comparison, and handles leading-zero country codes as string prefixes.

The approach accurately details splitting calls into endpoints via UNION ALL, string prefix joining to Country, comparing with the global call average, and relational complexity bounds. Alternatives and edge cases cover OR joins, separate caller/callee subqueries, UNION deduplication errors, domestic vs international calls, strict inequality, and leading zeroes.

App SQL and native SQL solutions both express the same CTE UNION ALL, inner joins, GROUP BY, and HAVING subquery logic with SHA-256 digests 6b2c814d9e864618fd110b78a8416edb943ffcb5a320e8fb2ed5606c03704902 and 958809ad87abcb63d75f189f77d845156f05d97a6032e5f26ba763e5ee5ac9ae. Verified submission remains untouched.

Statement structure and factual evidence confirmed Person, Country, and Calls schemas, three examples, four constraints, and 7 tables in reference mode. Bound to content SHA-256 f664f3fcf4447d4c2472c9e017471858bb4799b05c7420a91fd1e917f71df270.
